description: This file defines a Java interface named ModuleConfigurationService that extends a generic entity service for managing IntegrationModule instances. It declares methods for retrieving integration modules by module name and by code.

classes.name: ModuleConfigurationService
classes.description: A Java interface extending a generic service for managing IntegrationModule entities, providing methods to fetch modules based on module name and code.

methods.name: getIntegrationModules
methods.description: Retrieves a list of IntegrationModule instances matching the specified module name.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a single IntegrationModule instance based on its unique module code.
